# ============================================================================
# CANDIDATES, NOT SOURCES. Nothing in this file is crawled.
#
# These 1,037 Teamtailor career-site subdomains were recovered by a research
# pass in a container with no outbound access to job boards, so not one of them
# was probed by this project. docs/adding-a-source.md is explicit that a slug
# nobody has verified must not be registered, and at this project's fan-out a
# dead tenant is not free: it burns a request every crawl, reports as a failing
# source, and enough of them together trip the Source Health workflow's
# 35%-failure alarm, which is the signal that is supposed to mean a real
# platform broke.
#
# 34 slugs from this file's hand-curated head are registered in
# internal/services/teamtailor.go as TeamtailorCompanies. The rest are staged
# here until a CI job — the only place in this project with real network access
# — can probe them. The sections merged by "discovery/merge.py" carry "?" or an
# apply-URL guess where the employer name should be; none of those is
# registered, and they need more scrutiny than the rest, not less.
#
# Promotion rule, gated on content and not on status code: keep a slug whose
# https://<slug>.teamtailor.com/jobs.json answers 200 with a JSON object
# carrying an "items" array of length above zero. A career site that has been
# closed still answers on the apex host, so a status-code check would promote
# empty boards.
#
# The subdomain is used verbatim: it may carry a region label ("foothill.na") or
# an account-id suffix ("cameramatics-1639649453"), and both are part of the
# host.
#
# The verification claims and posting counts below are the upstream curator's,
# dated as annotated. They are recorded as provenance, not endorsed.
# ============================================================================
#
# Teamtailor career-site subdomains to poll (one per line, # = comment).
# The subdomain is the label in a company's career URL, e.g.
#   https://normative.teamtailor.com  -> normative
# It MAY carry a region label (foothill.na) or an account-id suffix
# (cameramatics-1639649453); use the full label verbatim -- it is the
# {label}.teamtailor.com host AND part of the posting id (apply-URL recovery).
# Polled by download/fetch_teamtailor.py via the public /jobs.json JSON Feed
# (no auth); the feed carries the full HTML description (no detail fetch needed).
#
# Harvested via site-scoped web search of *.teamtailor.com job URLs, then
# VERIFIED live against /jobs.json (kept only items>0, 2026-06-09).
